title: A Horizon for the Protocol
author: Jude Oyelaran
blurb: August Almeida, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
